name: fix-2737
title: #2737 — separate shapes in analytic: fast, each drawn valid, nothing moves

cases.title: Nine separate shapes, one per line, each answers at once
cases.lookFor: Every line draws its shape within a moment, the last as fast as the first. All nine shapes on the canvas, none of them crossed (no bow-tie).
cases.before: Each line slower than the last: «מעוין» about 17 s, «דלתון» about 73 s. «מקבילית» refused, and two quadrilaterals drawn crossed.

cases.title: A parallelogram beside four other shapes is accepted
cases.lookFor: «מקבילית» draws a fifth shape; no refusal.
cases.before: Refused: the parallelogram was said to be impossible.

cases.title: Seven free quadrilaterals are all drawn as simple shapes
cases.lookFor: Seven quadrilaterals, every one a simple four-sided shape: no sides crossing each other inside one shape.
cases.before: From the fifth on, two of them drawn crossed (a bow-tie).
